value: Mechanical vapour recompression added to a mothballed falling-film evaporator (FFE, 2,500 m2 tubes) at Alcoa Wagerup refinery: two low-speed compressors in series double waste-vapour pressure from 80 to 160 kPaA, raising condensing temperature by 19 degC (10 degC net of 9 degC boiling-point elevation) to evaporate Bayer liquor with renewable electricity instead of boiler steam.
Project closed Nov 2023 as financially unviable before commissioning (detailed design stage, FEL3 passed); MVR used in alumina refining only at one small facility in China

note: Compressor power consumption for the demonstration (two 2 MW compressors); about 0.3% of the power needed to retrofit MVR to all Australian alumina refineries.
Expected additional evaporation at Wagerup (production benefit 60 t/d alumina). Design, not measured.; target as extracted: "water-evaporation-additional" (normalised 2026-10-02)
New design peak evaporation; the FFE was originally designed for 85 t/h peak at 860 kPaA inlet steam.; target as extracted: "water-evaporation-peak" (normalised 2026-10-02)
Compressor discharge, doubled from 80 kPaA; design inlet steam/vapour 126 kPaA, separator 63 kPa (p.7).; target as extracted: "vapour" (normalised 2026-10-02)

Derived: 3.2 MW compressor power divided by the expected additional 56 t/h evaporation. A design-basis figure for this single-stage-pair retrofit, not measured; compressor power only, excludes pumps. Electricity: heating-value basis not applicable.
